ACCOUNT.comment: Bank accounts held at a Czech bank, 1993-1998: one row per account (4,500). Each account is held at a branch in a district and has a statement frequency. Money amounts in this database are in Czech crowns (CZK).

columns.DISTRICT_ID: District of the bank branch where the account is held.
columns.FREQUENCY: How often account statements are issued. Exactly 3 values (Czech): 'POPLATEK MESICNE' = monthly issuance (4,167 accounts), 'POPLATEK TYDNE' = weekly issuance (240), 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' = issuance after each transaction (93).
columns.DATE: Date the account was opened, as text 'YYYY-MM-DD', from 1993-01-01 to 1997-12-29.

CARD.comment: Payment cards issued by the bank: one row per card (892). A card is issued to a person for a specific account they can use (a disposition).

columns.DISP_ID: The disposition (person and account) the card was issued for.
columns.TYPE: Card type: 'junior' (145 cards), 'classic' (659) or 'gold' (88). Gold is the highest level, junior the lowest.
columns.ISSUED: Date the card was issued, as text 'YYYY-MM-DD', from 1993-11-07 to 1998-12-29.

CLIENT.comment: Customers of the bank: one row per person (5,369).

columns.BIRTH_DATE: Date of birth, as text 'YYYY-MM-DD', from 1911-08-20 to 1987-09-27.
columns.DISTRICT_ID: District where the client lives (their address), which can differ from the district of their account's branch.

DISP.comment: Dispositions: who may use which account. One row per person-account pair (5,369). Every account has exactly one owner and may have further authorised users.

columns.DISP_ID: Identifier of the disposition (a person's right to use an account).
columns.TYPE: 'OWNER' = the account holder (one per account, 4,500); 'DISPONENT' = another person authorised to use the account (869).

DISTRICT.comment: Demographic and economic statistics for each of the 77 districts (okresy) of the Czech Republic in the mid-1990s. A district is a local administrative area; districts are grouped into 8 regions.

columns.A2: District name, written without Czech accents, e.g. 'Benesov', 'Kladno', 'Brno - mesto'. 'Hl.m. Praha' is the capital city, Prague.
columns.A3: Region the district belongs to. One of 8 regions: 'Prague', 'central Bohemia', 'south Bohemia', 'west Bohemia', 'north Bohemia', 'east Bohemia', 'south Moravia', 'north Moravia'. Prague is a region of its own with a single district.
columns.A4: Number of inhabitants (population) of the district. 42,821 to 1,204,953; the largest is Hl.m. Praha.
columns.A5: Number of municipalities in the district with fewer than 500 inhabitants. 0 to 151.
columns.A6: Number of municipalities in the district with 500 to 1,999 inhabitants. 0 to 70.
columns.A7: Number of municipalities in the district with 2,000 to 9,999 inhabitants. 0 to 20.
columns.A8: Number of municipalities in the district with 10,000 or more inhabitants. 0 to 5.
columns.A9: Number of cities (towns) in the district. 1 to 11.
columns.A10: Ratio of urban inhabitants: the percentage of the population living in towns. 33.9 to 100.0; 100 for the four city districts (Hl.m. Praha, Brno - mesto, Plzen - mesto, Ostrava - mesto).
columns.A11: Average monthly salary in the district, in Czech crowns (CZK). 8,110 to 12,541; highest in Hl.m. Praha, lowest in Bruntal.
columns.A12: Unemployment rate in 1995, as a percentage (0.2 means 0.2%). 0.2 to 7.3. Unknown (NULL) for Jesenik.
columns.A13: Unemployment rate in 1996, as a percentage. 0.43 to 9.4.
columns.A14: Number of entrepreneurs per 1,000 inhabitants. 81 to 167.
columns.A15: Number of crimes committed in the district in 1995 (a count, not a rate). 818 to 85,677. Unknown (NULL) for Jesenik.
columns.A16: Number of crimes committed in the district in 1996 (a count, not a rate). 888 to 99,107.

LOAN.comment: Loans granted to accounts: one row per loan (682); an account has at most one loan. Amounts in Czech crowns (CZK).

columns.ACCOUNT_ID: The account the loan was granted to.
columns.DATE: Date the loan was granted (approved), as text 'YYYY-MM-DD', from 1993-07-05 to 1998-12-08.
columns.AMOUNT: Amount of the loan, CZK. 4,980 to 590,820.
columns.DURATION: Length of the loan in months: 12, 24, 36, 48 or 60.
columns.PAYMENTS: Monthly repayment amount, CZK (AMOUNT = PAYMENTS x DURATION). 304 to 9,910. Not a count of payments.
columns.STATUS: State of the loan. 'A' = contract finished, no problems (203); 'B' = contract finished, loan not paid back (31); 'C' = contract still running, payments OK so far (403); 'D' = contract still running, client in debt (45). Finished = A or B; running (active) = C or D; good = A or C; bad = B or D.

ORDER.comment: Payment orders (standing orders): instructions to pay money regularly from an account to another account, possibly at another bank. One row per order (6,471). Amounts in Czech crowns (CZK).

columns.ACCOUNT_ID: The account the money is paid from.
columns.BANK_TO: Two-letter code of the recipient's bank, one of 13 codes such as 'AB', 'CD', 'YZ'.
columns.AMOUNT: Amount paid by the order, CZK. 1 to 14,882.
columns.K_SYMBOL: Purpose of the payment (Czech): 'SIPO' = household payment (3,502 orders), 'UVER' = loan repayment (717), 'POJISTNE' = insurance payment (532), 'LEASING' = leasing payment (341); empty ('') = not specified (1,379).

TRANS.comment: Transactions on accounts: one row per movement of money (1,056,320), 1993-1998. Amounts and balances in Czech crowns (CZK).

columns.ACCOUNT_ID: The account the transaction is on.
columns.DATE: Date of the transaction, as text 'YYYY-MM-DD', from 1993-01-01 to 1998-12-31.
columns.TYPE: Direction (Czech): 'PRIJEM' = credit, money in (405,083); 'VYDAJ' = debit, money out (634,571); 'VYBER' = cash withdrawal, also money out (16,666). A withdrawal is VYDAJ or VYBER.
columns.OPERATION: How the money moved (Czech): 'VYBER' = withdrawal in cash (434,918); 'PREVOD NA UCET' = remittance (transfer) to another bank (208,283); 'VKLAD' = credit (deposit) in cash (156,743); 'PREVOD Z UCTU' = collection from another bank (65,226); 'VYBER KARTOU' = credit card withdrawal (8,036). NULL for interest credited by the bank (183,114).
columns.AMOUNT: Amount of money moved, CZK, always positive (0 to 87,400). Use TYPE for the direction.
columns.BALANCE: Account balance after the transaction, CZK. Can be negative (-41,126 to 209,637).
columns.K_SYMBOL: Purpose of the transaction (Czech): 'UROK' = interest credited (183,114); 'SLUZBY' = payment for the account statement (bank charge, 155,832); 'SIPO' = household payment (118,065); 'DUCHOD' = old-age pension (30,338); 'POJISTNE' = insurance payment (18,500); 'UVER' = loan repayment (13,580); 'SANKC. UROK' = penalty interest charged on a negative balance (1,577). Not specified: NULL (481,881) or a single space ' ' (53,433).
columns.BANK: Two-letter code of the partner's bank for transfers, one of 13 codes such as 'AB', 'YZ'. NULL when there is no partner bank (782,812 transactions).
columns.ACCOUNT: The partner's account number for transfers. NULL or 0 when there is no partner account.
